heading: Beyond Engineering.
paragraphs: Abdelrahman Hesham is an electronics engineer based in Cairo, specialising in power electronics and analog PCB design: switch-mode supplies, isolated power, and Li-ion charging and protection.
His most complete work is the PSK Gate System, a race-timing gate for stadium tracks. He carried it from schematic and layout through client validation, and assembled 12 working units.
When a system misbehaves in the field, he looks for the physical cause first. On the PSK Gate it was sunrise interference on the IR sensors, and a red-LED sensor removed it.
Every design is verified in LTspice and Simulink before a board is committed, then proven on the bench with an oscilloscope and a multimeter.

He is completing an M.Sc. in Mechatronics at Ain Shams University, researching analog front-end IC design for current and torque sensing. He is looking for hardware design work in power electronics or analog PCB design, and is open to relocating.
